greenlight.title: Greenlight Gate
greenlight.subtitle: Evaluate book ideas before writing to maximize ROI
greenlight.infoBannerDescription: The Greenlight Gate helps you evaluate book ideas before investing time and money. Enter your concept details to get:
greenlight.infoListItem2: Market size and capture rate estimates
greenlight.tipRealistic: Be realistic with costs: Include cover design, editing, formatting, and initial marketing spend.
greenlight.tipResearch: Research comparable titles: Find ASINs of similar books in your niche for better market size estimates.
greenlight.tipSeries: Consider series advantage: First books in a series often have lower ROI but drive sales for later books.
greenlight.tipTime: Factor in time: A lower ROI book that you can write quickly may outperform a high-ROI book that takes months.
